notes.title: v2.0 Update
notes.notes:
New Features:
Added Championship Mode.

New:
Added new daily quest for Championship.
Added new ranking and rewards system for Championship.
Added Competition Points system.


Major Improvements
Card details will now display primitive properties.
Card details will now display energy activation cost for Spells and Triggers.
CD bar display direction is now inverted.

Major Bugs:
Fixed an issue that player gets extra ineligible rubies from card reset.
Fixed an issue that assassination is set to Shrine Alliance faction.
Fixed an issue that may causes abnormalities when resurrection happens.
Fixed an issue that Frosthunter doesn’t increase maximum CD.
Fixed an issue that caused error when purchasing coins in shop.
Fixed an issue when Lord of Templars fails to activate when its affected by Hell Legion Triggers.
Fixed an issue that some visual effects are missing for some cards after v1.9.

Major Balance Changes:
Die Together: Activation condition is now based on enemy Creature. Basic difference value changed from 50 to 100. CD 8=>5. 
Da Ji: Activation chances are limited to 3 times. Basic target HP changed from 600 to 500. Target’s Tier can’t be higher than this card’s.
Divine Shield: DEF increment is now 20 instead of 30.
Dragon Glass: CD 4=>7.
Blindfold: Attack targeting won’t be the same after effected by this card by chance.
Dragon Eggs: CD 7=>10. Baby Dragon spawned inherits this cards' power.
Philosophers Stone: Initial HP after revival increased from 20% to 25%.

notes.title: v1.4 Update
notes.notes:
Features:
Summoner Command System
At the beginning of battle, summoner can issue targeting commands to (non-Area attack) Creatures. Those creatures who have been given targeting commands keep attack the targets until it’s destroyed. Thereafter, the cards will select following targets based on it’s own targeting property.
During campaign quests, summoner can issue commands anytime.


New:
Added 6 new cards (1 Star Normal Card x1, 1 Star Prize Card x1, 2 Star Prize Card x1, 4 Star Normal Card x2)
Ladder grand season S1 rewards
All those cards that are nerfed in new version can be reset for free once.
Added S2, S3 card packs (Legend card guaranteed in S2, Epic card guaranteed in S3)
Added Guild Exp card
Player level limit increased to 120.
Card level limit increased to 50. (Max level)
“Legacy Trial” now has 60 quests available.
Added explanations for normal, prize, special cards in library.
Add visual effect of ability for Ice Elemental

Major Improvements:
Players will be redirected to previous interface after PVP battles or campaign quests.
Guild president will be demoted to Member if he/she hasn’t contributed in 14 days. Member of the highest contribution will be promoted to new president.
Card status widget will now show card’s attack target or card type in battle screen.
When creature activates, a hint of attack target will be displayed.

Major Balance changes:
Ability Redo: Corrupted Wolf Pack, Die Together.
Imprison: Basic damage 400=>450. Level up property incensement is doubled.
White Tiger Taoist: ATK265->435 =>365->435.
Loli: HP1100=>1300。Ability now also reduces Special damage. Melee damage received increased from 10% to 20%. 
Empty Fort: Chance increased from 15% to 20%.
Dragon Eggs: CD-3。
Royal Girl Hunter: HP 1450=>1550。ATK 300-370=> 320-410。
Kendoka Girl： Ability factor 2=>1.5。
Guardian： Basic damage 400=>450。
Mutant： Unarmored armortype is also considered as ability’s activating condition.
Hell Fire：CD-1
Dryad： Minimum ATK 185=>235.
Blindfold： The card will not be destroyed after activation. It now can negate the summoner commands. CD 1=>5. Basic affecting chance 75%=>50%.
Trap Detection： CD 3=>4。
Meteor: CD 7=>8。
Elven Fairy：HP 1550=>1350。
